newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 25.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices- Nov 25.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

-------- COMMENTS - Bunker prices edged higher in line with the rise in cargo prices, traders said. Most sellers were disappointed with the small volumes traded with some blaming it on a typical sluggish Monday while others on the high cargo prices. They said the high cargo levels have forced most sellers to raise their offers which have pushed buyers to the sidelines.
